description: Dependency graph for PIP S-001 (this spec) and the OpenBrain/PIP tickets it depends on or unblocks. Statuses are a snapshot recorded from each owning spec at the time TK-001 closed; each node's owning SPEC.md remains authoritative if they later disagree.

nodes.title: Define the PIP-to-OpenBrain transport, auth, provenance/freshness propagation, client identity, and disable/recovery contract.

Prove two approved client fixtures plus disable/recovery behavior.
Source freshness and operational readiness (freshness payload).
Add source filters plus provenance/freshness response fields to implementation and OpenAPI contract.
Re-probe the deployed contract for unauthorized, invalid, empty, and successful requests.

Implement one read-only retrieval round trip through the chosen adapter.
Prove two approved clients and operational disable/recovery behavior.
